sources.title: Pareto distribution — Probability Distribution Explorer documentation
sources.snippet: Parameters The Pareto distribution has two parameters, $\alpha$ and ${y}_{\mathrm{min}}$. The parameter $\alpha$ sets the power in the power law and ${y}_{\mathrm{min}}$ is a lower cutoff to ensure that the distribution is normalizable. Both $\alpha$ and ${y}_{\mathrm{min}}$ must be positive.

sources.title: Two-dimensional magnetic interactions in LaFeAsO
sources.snippet: Inelastic neutron scattering measurements demonstrate that the magnetic interactions in antiferromagnetic LaFeAsO are two-dimensional. Spin wave velocities within the Fe layer and the magnitude of the spin gap are similar to the \textit{A}Fe$_2$As$_2$ based materials. However, the ratio of interlayer and intralayer exchange is found to be less than $\sim 10^{-4}$ in LaFeAsO, very similar to the cuprates, and $\sim$ 100 times smaller than that found in \textit{A}Fe$_2$As$_2$ compounds.
